traits.name: methodical
traits.reason: Lines log counts (10 ore, 25 wood, 7 legs) but show no single unproven build with cost, result and order of operations recorded.

traits.name: observant
traits.reason: Greets GrandadPail and Treacleaxe by position, but no line notes any structure's type, purpose or pieces; moves look like patrol legs.

traits.name: generous
traits.reason: Twice offers 24 wood and asks what others need; the offers are public. No findings shared or published, and no world credit given.

traits.name: plain_spoken
traits.reason: Lines are short and carry coordinates and counts, with no adjectives. The dry aside is absent.

traits.name: patient
traits.reason: Steady gathering, storing and walking without improvising. No half-built test is noted, so the evidence is limited.

traits.name: curious
traits.reason: Asks GrandadPail what they are building and what they need, but never asks what a structure is for or reads compounds.
